{{Quote|Last week we tracked a gang of Lamproid smugglers to a meeting ground a short distance from this terminal. The smugglers dispersed but they left us with a problem. Apparently they had collected a small menagerie of ill-tempered animals to stage a live version of dejarik. The Lamproids freed the animals when we arrived. Now the creatures have built lairs all over the place. This problem is best handled by experienced hunters who know the area. CorSec will pay a nominal fee for the destruction of any of these lairs.|Mission terminal message from the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Animal Control Division]]|<ref name="SWG:LSaMB">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Lamproid Smugglers: a Messy Bunch}}</ref>}}
A gang of '''Lamproid smugglers''' was active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:LSaMB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] staged a game of [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] on Corellia using real animals. When the [[Corellian Security Force]] showed up, the [[Lamproid/Legends|Lamproids]] escaped, leaving the beasts to roam free. The Corellian Security Force's [[Animal Control Division]] put out a briefing to [[mission terminal]]s offering a small reward to anyone willing to exterminate the smuggled animals.<ref name="SWG:LSaMB" />
